DCIT, Circle-1(1), Tirupati vs M/s. Indus Coffee Private Limited — ITA 1139/HYD/2025
court_cases.status: Appeal by Revenue concerning transfer pricing / s.92C reference and reimbursement of expenses (Rs. 28,214); assessee's exports stated to be destined for Malaysia, with the Tribunal distinguishing the Vayhan Coffee Limited precedent where the final destination was St. Petersburg, Russia via Pasir Gudang

rf_supply: No direct evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS found for this company. Relevant context: in ITA 1139/HYD/2025 (ITAT Hyderabad, 19.08.2026) the Tribunal recorded that Indus Coffee's own exports were destined for Malaysia, and expressly distinguished the precedent in Vayhan Coffee Limited where the final destination was St. Petersburg, Russia via Pasir Gudang. So the Russia routing appears in the comparable case, not in Indus Coffee's own shipments. Source: https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22Indus%20Coffee%22%20doctypes%3Aitat
